api.description: ASP.NET Core controller layer. All HTTP entry points live here.

required_patterns.controller-base: All controllers extend ControllerBase (not Controller); no view support.
required_patterns.route-convention: Class-level [Route("api/[controller]")] + [ApiController]; no method-level route prefixes beyond HTTP verb attributes.
required_patterns.return-type: All action methods return Task<IActionResult> and delegate work entirely to an injected I*Service; no business logic in controllers.
required_patterns.service-injection: Services are injected via constructor into a private I*Service property (not field).

architectural_constraints.no-direct-repo-access: Controllers must never reference repositories or DbContext directly — only through a service interface.
architectural_constraints.swagger-filter: Every endpoint automatically receives an Accept-Language header parameter via SwaggerHeaderFilter registered globally.
architectural_constraints.cors: CORS is locked to http://localhost:4200; no per-controller CORS overrides.

service-layer.description: Business logic layer. All services inherit BaseService for UnitOfWork, Mapper, and Localization access.

required_patterns.base-class: All services extend BaseService, which provides protected IUnitOfWork UnitOfWork, protected IMapper Mapper, and public ILocalizationService Localization.
required_patterns.response-wrapper: Every public service method returns ResponseDto<T>. Success/error state is expressed via GetSuccessResponse() / GetErrorResponse() fluent methods — HTTP status codes are not set here.
required_patterns.validation-via-exceptions: Input validation in services throws typed custom exceptions (NameRequiredException, InvalidRequestException, ObjectNotFoundException); the middleware translates these to HTTP 400/404/500.
required_patterns.unit-of-work-commit: All writes (create/update/delete) are staged through the repository but only persisted by calling await UnitOfWork.CommitAsync(); the return value (> default(int)) is used to determine success.
required_patterns.mapster-mapping: Object mapping uses Mapster via the injected IMapper (from BaseService). New entity-to-DTO or DTO-to-entity mappings are registered in Meezan.Services/Mapper/ using IRegister.

architectural_constraints.no-ef-in-services: Services must never reference AppDbContext or EF types directly; all persistence goes through IUnitOfWork.
architectural_constraints.localization-for-messages: User-facing response messages must be sourced from ILocalizationService (e.g., Localization.GeneralError) not hardcoded strings, wherever a key exists.
architectural_constraints.password-hashing: Passwords must be hashed before persistence; use the injected IPasswordHash service (PBKDF2-based).

data-layer.description: EF Core repositories, DbContext, entity configurations, Unit of Work, and migrations.

required_patterns.base-repository: All repositories extend BaseRepository<T>, which provides CRUD methods (CreateAsyn, Update, Delete, FirstOrDefaultAsync, GetAllAsync) backed by Lazy<AppDbContext>.
required_patterns.lazy-dbcontext: AppDbContext is injected as Lazy<AppDbContext> into repositories and UnitOfWork to defer materialisation until the first database call.
required_patterns.unit-of-work: UnitOfWork implements IUnitOfWork; each repository property instantiates a new repository passing the shared Lazy<AppDbContext>. CommitAsync() calls SaveChangesAsync().
required_patterns.entity-configuration: Every entity has a corresponding IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> in Meezan.Repositories/EntityConfiguration/ using Fluent API. All audit columns (CreationTime, LastModificationTime, IsDeleted) are configured with SQL defaults (GETDATE(), false).
required_patterns.table-naming: AppDbContext.SingularizeTableNames ensures table names match the entity class name (not pluralised EF default).
required_patterns.data-seeding: Lookup/reference data (MailStatus, MailType) is seeded via the modelBuilder.SeedInitialData() extension in InitialDataSeeding.cs.
required_patterns.base-entity-inheritance: All entities must inherit BaseEntity (provides IsDeleted, CreationTime, LastModificationTime). Multilingual lookup entities use BaseMultilingualTextEntity (adds EnName, ArName, EnDescription, ArDescription).

architectural_constraints.sql-server-only: Data layer is hard-wired to SQL Server via UseSqlServer; do not introduce other providers.
architectural_constraints.no-lazy-loading: UseLazyLoadingProxies(false) is set explicitly; navigation properties must be loaded via explicit includes.
architectural_constraints.singular-tables: Table names are singularised globally; do not override to plural naming.

notification.description: Transactional email abstraction. Used to send and log emails atomically with business Meezan.

required_patterns.mail-sender: Email is sent via the IMailSender interface (injected into services). MailSender wraps System.Net.Mail / SMTP.
required_patterns.mail-entity-logging: Every sent email creates a Mail entity that is committed to the database in the same UnitOfWork transaction as the triggering business operation.
required_patterns.mail-dto-preparation: Services prepare a (MailDto, MailSettingDto) tuple before calling IMailSender.SendMail; settings come from the injected MailSettings configuration object.

architectural_constraints.no-direct-smtp: Services must never instantiate SmtpClient directly; always use IMailSender.
architectural_constraints.atomic-persistence: Mail records and the associated business entity must be committed together via a single UnitOfWork.CommitAsync() call.

background-jobs.description: Hangfire-based background job scheduling. Jobs are dispatched from controllers via Hangfire client APIs.

required_patterns.job-service: Job logic lives in IJobService / JobService; controllers receive IBackgroundJobClient and IRecurringJobManager via constructor injection.
required_patterns.job-types: Four job types are supported: fire-and-forget (Enqueue), delayed (Schedule), recurring (AddOrUpdate with Cron), and continuation (ContinueJobWith).
required_patterns.dedicated-db: Hangfire uses a separate SQL Server database (HFDBConString) from the application database (DBConString).

architectural_constraints.no-hosted-service: Do not use IHostedService or BackgroundService for scheduled/recurring work; use Hangfire.
architectural_constraints.job-logic-in-service: Job body logic must be in IJobService methods, not inlined in controller action lambdas.

required_patterns.localization-service: All user-facing string constants (errors, success messages) come from ILocalizationService, which reads from localizationFile.json keyed by culture.
required_patterns.culture-negotiation: The Accept-Language request header (injected into every Swagger operation) drives CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, which LocalizationFileReader uses to pick the locale.
required_patterns.adding-keys: New localizable strings require an entry in localizationFile.json with both 'en' and 'ar' values, and a corresponding property on ILocalizationService / LocalizationService.

architectural_constraints.no-resource-files: Do not use .resx / IStringLocalizer — the project uses its own JSON-based reader.
architectural_constraints.both-languages-required: Every key in localizationFile.json must have both 'en' and 'ar' entries.

ioc-composition.description: Dependency injection wired through static Resolver classes; no attribute-based or convention-based scanning.

required_patterns.resolver-classes: DI registrations are grouped into static resolver classes: CoreServicesResolver (services + mapper), UnitOfWorkResolver (DbContext + UoW + Lazy<>), CommonResolver (mail, file, validator, http). Each exposes named static methods called from Program.cs.
required_patterns.scoped-services: Services and repositories are registered as Scoped. Singletons are limited to IPasswordHash, MailSettings, and Mapster TypeAdapterConfig.
required_patterns.mapster-scan: Mapster IRegister implementations are discovered via TypeAdapterConfig.GlobalSettings.Scan(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly()) in CoreServicesResolver.ResolveMapper.

architectural_constraints.no-attribute-di: Do not use [FromServices] attribute injection or service locator patterns; always use constructor injection.
architectural_constraints.resolver-per-project: Each class library project that owns registrations has its own Resolver class; do not register foreign-project services from another project's resolver.

error-handling.description: Global exception-to-HTTP mapping via custom middleware and typed exception classes.

required_patterns.custom-exceptions: Three typed exceptions exist: ObjectNotFoundException (→ 404), NameRequiredException (→ 400), InvalidRequestException (→ 400). Throw these from service layer to signal domain errors.
required_patterns.middleware: ErrorHandlingMiddleware catches all unhandled exceptions in the pipeline and writes a JSON-serialised error message with the appropriate HTTP status code.
required_patterns.no-controller-try-catch: Controllers do not contain try/catch; exception handling is entirely the middleware's responsibility.

architectural_constraints.new-exceptions-in-services: New custom exception types must be placed in Meezan.Services/CustomExceptions/ and mapped in ErrorHandlingMiddleware.
architectural_constraints.json-error-body: Error responses are a JSON-serialised string (not an object); do not change this shape without updating consumers.
